title: docs(skills): objectstack-ai teaches knowledge_source as metadata (shipped vs run-time mount, package-scoped identity)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Part of #37310

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用 AI（技能文档或 MCP 搭建）写知识源的作者，现在看到的是新写法：知识源是一份元数据，用 `name`、逐个列出要索引的字段、可以不写存储；MCP 新建知识源暂不提供起始模板（模板里的占位对象和字段会被当成真实值存进去），等设置页表单从作者输入构建 `source` 后再加。
- 为什么做：知识库检索专题（按调用者权限过滤的知识检索）第三阶段的教学一行，替照着技能写知识源的 AI 解决"照文档写出来却被拒绝"的问题。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是技能里某句教法不准，AI 写出的知识源在保存时被明确拒绝并给出修法；不会悄悄索引错的字段；改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：合并（技能文档是受治理面，由你亲手落地）；本 PR 只完成卡片的一部分：发布校验的五条规则名要等对应的校验改动（#37971）合并后再补，新建模板要等设置页表单，所以卡片保持打开。

## What changes

**`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, § Knowledge Sources (RAG)** (ADR-0161 K4, K5, K6 item 6; rows 3a and 3b as merged):

- A source is a `knowledge_source` item: shipped in a package (`knowledgeSources`, `*.knowledge-source.ts` / `.yml`) or authored in Studio or over MCP. `KnowledgeServicePlugin({ sources })` and `registerSource` are a second door for the same schema, and a code registration and an environment item of one name are one slot, the second refused. A source's identity is its package and `name`: `search_knowledge` lists a package's source as `NAMESPACE-NAME` (bare for a source no package holds). A shipped item (a `knowledgeSources` entry) mounts the knowledge service and its store with no `requires: ['knowledge']` (#37306, PR #38026); an app that ships no source and authors its sources at run time needs `requires: ['knowledge']`, or its items are never indexed (as main's `knowledge-rag.mdx` § Turning it on says).
- The key table is the v1 keys of K4: `name`, `label` / `description`, `adapter` (optional; omitted ⇒ the deployment's store, else the only one registered, refused naming them when several and none is the deployment's), `source.kind`, `source.object`, `source.content` (an explicit non-empty list; why `'*'` is refused: embedding is egress, K5), `source.metadataFields`, `source.where`, `source.split`, `refresh.onRecordChange`, `aiExposed`. The old Hygiene column's advice (meaningful text only, never ids or system fields; `where` keeps drafts out) now lives in the `content` and `where` rows, and says `content`.
- Egress and cost (K4): the first build sends every listed field of every matching record to the embedding provider; a run-time save needs `manage_knowledge_sources` beside `manage_metadata` and passes save-time admission.
- The retired keys by name, each with its fix, as the tombstones read: `id` → `name`, `contentFields` → `content`, `embedding`, `vectorStore`, `adapterConfig`, `refresh.cron`, and the `file` / `http` arms with their four keys; `os migrate meta --from 18` for a stack, by hand for a registration in code.
- The checked example drops `adapter: 'pgvector'` (the deployment's store) and its comments; it is otherwise row 3a's block.
- `split`: `strategy` is required once `split` is written (`recursive` only when `split` is omitted); the adapter-list aside is gone.
- The closing note: `topK` is a `search_knowledge` argument; rerank and hybrid weighting are no source key, and no shipped store has a setting for either (`knowledge-pgvector` and `knowledge-turso` fuse their legs by RRF with a fixed `RRF_K = 60`, `pgvector-adapter.ts:124`, `turso-adapter.ts:95`; no store plugin's options interface has a rerank, weight or fusion key).
- The routing line in `skills/objectstack-mcp-build/SKILL.md` ("An agent skill, tool or knowledge source | objectstack-ai") stays true: the section name is unchanged, so it is not edited.

**Not in this PR, on purpose (amendments 7221575164 and 7224082428):** the five `os validate` / publish rule ids of PR #37971 (`knowledge-source-object-unknown`, `knowledge-source-field-unknown`, `knowledge-source-object-not-searchable`, `knowledge-source-system-object-not-ai-readable`, `knowledge-source-field-never-indexed`). #37971 is still open, so this PR is `Part of #37310`: that part follows on this branch after #37971 lands (the keyword then returns to `Fixes`), or on a later PR if this one lands first. The create seed is also left open: it waits for the Studio form (#37309, row 5).

**`skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`.** Case 3 (kb_article on PostgreSQL) and case 9 (policy_doc, `markdown` split) now expect `name` and `content`, and forbid a written `contentFields:` key; case 3 also forbids a written wildcard (`['*'],`, `['*'] }`), `embedding:` and `vectorStore:`, and its `topK` token becomes `topK:` (the key written) because the skill now names `topK` as a search argument. Case 9 also requires `name:` and forbids an `id:` spelling; case 13 forbids the double-quoted wildcard forms. New case 14 asks for an app that ships no source and authors one at run time, and requires the `requires: ['knowledge']` line (either quote style), with no `contentFields:`. New case 13 asks for a source that indexes "every text field" and expects an explicit list, the wildcard declined because embedding is egress, and no written `contentFields:` or wildcard.

**`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-create-seeds.ts`: unchanged (byte-identical to `main`).** A `knowledge_source` create seed was tried and withdrawn at `4c965f4a5e` (comment 7229668414). Its object binding and content list sit inside `source`, and the Studio create flow (`buildCreateModeBody` / `seedPlaceholderKeys` in app-shell's `createBody.ts`) clears placeholder identity at the top level only, so it would have saved `example_object` / `example_field` into a new source: the objectui#12810 defect. No schema-valid seed avoids this, because `source.object` and a non-empty `content` (K5) are required and nested. `knowledge_source` stays on `KNOWN_UNSEEDED`, whose comment now gives the reason: a seed waits until the Studio form (#37309, row 5) builds `source` from the author's input. The card allows this ("or the type stays on `KNOWN_UNSEEDED` with the reason").

**`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts`.** One case beside the flow contract case, over the real protocol and the boot type registry: `list_metadata_items` with `contract: true` for `knowledge_source` serves no `createSeed`; `contractPath` `/properties/source/properties/content` serves the content rule (`minItems: 1`, `minLength: 1`, a pattern that refuses `*` and admits `body`); the served schema carries no `id` or `contentFields` tombstone; a hand-written source with one object and one field saves as a draft; the same item with `content: ['*']`, with an `id`, or with `contentFields` is refused `422 INVALID_METADATA`, the last two naming their tombstone's prescription ("use `name`", "use `content`"); nothing else is written.

**Platform catalog (review round, `6f2e756f58`).** The generator's Boot cell (`packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts`) reads ``on `requires`, or a shipped `knowledgeSources` item`` for a provider that declares `mountedBy`; `packages/spec/scripts/platform-catalog.test.ts` pins that cell, with `record-context` as the control that still reads ``on `requires` ``. `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md` is regenerated.

**Token ratchet.** The standing ruling, verbatim and untranslated: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068, letter B). Paid down first, in the same file: the wiring paragraph's package list, the old `source.kind` Hygiene column (folded into two rows), the example's four comments restating table rows and its `refresh: { onRecordChange: true }` line restating the default, and the split passage's adapter aside. The row moves 6609 → 6639, the measured remainder, pinned at the measurement. Review round (`6f2e756f58`): after paying down the intro's restating clause, its separate `search_knowledge` sentence, the "one name is one source" clause and the longer closing note, the row moves 6639 → 6695 (+56, the measured remainder) under the same ruling. Reproduction: `ceil(($(wc -c < skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md) - 27) / 4)` = ceil(26779 / 4) = 6695.

## Tests

**Review round at `6f2e756f58`** (merges `main` at `58be6770ab`; note 7230668192): unlocked, 35 commands, each exit 0, including `check-skills-token-ratchet` (row 6695), `check:nul-bytes`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:skill-links`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:published-files`; `gen:skill-refs` exit 0. NOT MEASURED locally (verify lock never acquired in six tries): `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:yaml-examples`, the platform-catalog test, `metadata-create-seeds.test.ts`, the MCP contract case, eval case 14. CI on this head is the reading for them. overlap-check: `VERDICT overlap exit 1`, the same #36158-against-main conflict in the ratchet file; `origin/main`, #38032 and #38013 merge cleanly.

The lock was saturated: about 70 minutes of queueing, two dogfood runs ahead. One locked round ran at `3407f7fe6e`; the second round was not reached. What was not measured locally is marked below, and CI runs it.

They are read here as the closure build's gaps (only `runtime^...` was built) and not as this diff's; CI `TypeScript Type Check` decides.

The ablation restored `main`'s `SKILL.md` into the working tree only (`git restore --source=8d34c4404f`, `git hash-object` = `88a20cb583`). The run ran, and then `HEAD`'s file came back (`fc845724ac` both on disk and at `HEAD`). An earlier run of case 13 on this text failed with-skill only on the token `['*']`, which a correct answer quoted while explaining the refusal. The forbidden token is now the written wildcard (`['*'],` / `['*'] }`), and the table above is after that change.

## Acceptance notes

- The acceptance grep (`git grep -n -E "contentFields|'\*'|adapter: 'ragflow'" skills/objectstack-ai`) returns eight lines. In `SKILL.md`, three: the `content` row ("`'*'` is refused") and two lines of the retired-keys paragraph. In the eval file, five: the reference answers of cases 3 and 13, which name both as retired, and the `must_not_contain` lists of cases 3, 9 and 13, which forbid a written `contentFields:` and a written wildcard (`['*'],`, `['*'] }`). The card itself asks the eval to fail on `contentFields` or `'*'`, which puts the forbidden token on the assertion line. The reviewer decides whether those lines count as "naming a retired key as retired".
- `adapter: 'ragflow'` has no hit: #37004 already removed it.
- The new MCP pin is an `it` inside the existing real-protocol `describe` of `mcp-authoring.test.ts`, beside the flow contract case, because that describe holds the real-protocol harness (`realProtocol`, `STUDIO_BASE`). It is in the shared harness file, not a new file.
- **Premise correction (card item 3).** The card asks the served contract to carry "the tombstones' prescriptions as the describes read". It does not, by design: the served JSON Schema drops every `retiredKey()` tombstone (`{ not: {} }`; see the note in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-type-schema.ts`: the served schema publishes what an author MAY write). The prescription reaches an MCP author through the save refusal instead. The pin asserts both halves: the tombstone is absent from the served schema, and a save that writes the retired key is refused naming its replacement.
- The save half of the MCP pin covers row 3a's parse. Row 4's checks (#37971) are not on main, so a hand-written draft is not yet judged by them here. Today the save passes with no knowledge service mounted ("no knowledge service judges nothing").
- overlap-check before the PR: `VERDICT overlap exit 1`. `origin/main`, #38032 and #38013 merge cleanly. #36158 (a draft last updated 2026-11-25) conflicts in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`. That conflict is #36158's own against `origin/main`: `git merge-tree origin/main` with #36158's head conflicts in the same file, and every conflict hunk is at line 798 or later, away from this branch's hunk near line 453. Reported here, not resolved.
